Scope: Selected physical input, source, IL, map and complete contract checks; no ETS application or runtime test

ReviewedReplacements.Reason: Invokes the captured synchronous response handler, then wraps its return value with Task.FromResult. It does not read response content or catch handler exceptions.
Maps status 500 to KnxApiError; all other statuses produce a WebServiceError containing status and reason phrase.
Forwards the absolute Uri string to the generic content-result overload.
Sends GET, propagates a failed HTTP Result, or decodes successful content through ReadContentAsync<T> and returns Result.Ok<T>. The inner read preserves strings and deserializes other types as JSON.
Stores the supplied boolean in the initialization backing field; contains no disposal operation.
Unsubscribes this callback from the captured DevKit dongle readiness event and appends a new EtsDongle wrapper to its manager collection.
Adds an EtsDongle wrapper immediately when the DevKit ready flag is true, otherwise subscribes a callback that adds it once the event fires.
Constructs an EtsLicense wrapper from the supplied DevKit or CloudKit license; the two overloads preserve their distinct parameter types.
Constructs an EtsLicense wrapper from the supplied DevKit or CloudKit license; the two overloads preserve their distinct parameter types.
Matches an enumerated CloudKit ID against the captured ID of a newly discovered entry.

Sets the supplied key, creates an output directory using the archive basename and extracts there. Only BadPasswordException/ZlibException are converted to InvalidPasswordError; other exceptions escape.

Requires an existing container file, extracts it using ZipProtection.Password, then extracts Device/*.knxtempl with the same key if Device exists; otherwise returns the target directory. Directory input returns an empty list only after the file check.

BehaviorLimits: Common arx::c delegates to DevKit akj::l, whose current body returns false. Intended meaning remains unresolved and no alias is assigned.
InitializeAsync performs initialization synchronously and returns Task.CompletedTask.
Request transport checks cancellation before sending but passes CancellationToken.None to the client; transport cancellation maps to NoInternetConnectionError.
Generic ExecuteWithErrorMap catches operation exceptions before mapping failed results; the nongeneric overload propagates operation exceptions.
A null synchronous response handler captured by the adapter faults when invoked; the asynchronous overload supplies a default error only when its own delegate is null.
Cloud refresh releases the semaphore on success rather than in a finally block; a worker exception can leave its completion source unfinished.
Cloud session pause retries five times with blocking exponential waits; behavior is preserved.

Nested ZIP extraction converts only BadPasswordException and ZlibException to a failure Result; successful extraction deletes source archives and derives output paths by removing exactly nine final characters.
An empty key sequence can dereference a null extraction Result. No archive was opened or extracted by this review.
The 6.4 InputFilePath backing field is decompiled as an automatic property and was not renamed; the existing property spelling is readable.
